title: Password
description: A connection password for a database branch.

id.description: The unique identifier of the password.

name.description: The descriptive name of the password.

role.description: The access role for the password.

hostname.description: The hostname for connecting with this password.

username.description: The username for connecting with this password.

database_branch.description: The branch this password is associated with.

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the password expires. Null if no expiration.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the password was created.

renewable.description: Whether the password can be renewed.
